name: Death by Debt
source:
Alastair Cochraine has just lost his job. Threatened with eviction but determined to keep his apartment—and his cats—Alastair sets off on an adventure to pad his bank account. But good jobs are hard to find in this town, and he’s about to discover just how far he’ll go to pay the rent. Potential employers include an anxious alchemist, a morose mobster, and a calculating crime boss. Can Alastair succeed, or will the city swallow him up?

[From [url=https://mintbiscuits.itch.io/death-by-debt]official site[/url]]
translation:
阿拉斯泰尔·科克林刚刚失业。阿拉斯泰尔面临被驱逐的威胁，但决心保留他的公寓和他的猫，他开始了一场冒险，以充实他的银行账户。但在这个小镇上很难找到好工作，他即将发现自己要花多少钱来支付房租。潜在的雇主包括焦虑的炼金术士、阴郁的黑帮和精于算计的犯罪头目。阿拉斯泰尔能否成功，还是这座城市会吞没他？

[来自[url=https://mintbiscuits.itch.io/death-by-debt]官方网站[/url]]
